description: This Java class defines a business event for changes in loan balance within the Fineract project. It extends a parent event class and encapsulates details related to a loan's balance change, including its type and the referenced loan object.

classes.name: LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event indicating that a loan's balance has changed. It extends LoanBusinessEvent and holds a reference to a Loan object.

methods.name: LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific Loan instance.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for this event.
